text:
Ivy L: FYI customer NimbleApps reported invoice 0xA3B missing PAYG usage lines but shows a duplicated reserved capacity discount. They attached the PDF.
Nora (Billing): that's odd. reserved discount should only apply to committed seats, not to PAYG. Any logs?
Ivy L: billing-bot emitted an error during the finalize step then retried. Logs show apply_discount called twice with same invoice_id but different attempt ids.
Billing Bot: ERROR: billing_finalize: race_condition detected invoice=0xA3B job=finalize-203 retry=1 detail="discount_apply_conflict"
Ben R: paste the log snippet? looking for idempotency token.
Ivy L: here's the block:
```
2026-03-25T09:12:03Z WARN billing_service: finalize_attempt invoice=0xA3B user=nimbleapps attempt=1
2026-03-25T09:12:03Z ERROR discounts: apply_reserved_discount invoice=0xA3B discount_id=rd_55 conflict=true
2026-03-25T09:12:04Z INFO billing_service: finalize_aborted invoice=0xA3B reason=partial_commit
2026-03-25T09:12:05Z INFO billing_service: retrying finalize invoice=0xA3B attempt=2 idempotency_key=none
2026-03-25T09:12:06Z INFO discounts: apply_reserved_discount invoice=0xA3B discount_id=rd_55 conflict=false applied=true
2026-03-25T09:12:06Z INFO invoices: pdf_rendered invoice=0xA3B pdf=pdf_a3b_v1
```
Tariq: No idempotency key on retry. That's the bug. The code treats the second attempt as fresh and re-applies the discount record, which causes duplication in line items display (and unreconciled totals in some cases).
Olivia (Finance): What's the customer impact in dollars? NimbleApps sees -$120 reserved discount twice, but PAYG usage lines are missing so total shows lower usage than expected; their support rep flagged it.
Ben R: quick DB query indicates 5 invoices in finalize-203 batch where invoice_lines->> 'type' missing 'usage' and discounts table has duplicate rows for the same invoice/disc pair.
Nora (Billing): remediation options? reissue corrected invoices + credit notes, or quietly regenerate PDFs and send corrected PDFs? They already received PDFs.
Ivy L: suggested plan:
- run a consistency query to enumerate affected invoices (pdf_exists=true && discounts.duplicate_for_invoice=true OR usage_lines_count=0)
- for invoices with duplicate discount and amount_diff > $1, create credit note + corrected invoice and notify customer
- for invoices only missing usage lines but totals unaffected, silently regenerate and replace PDF (no credit)
- patch code to make finalize step idempotent using finalize_idempotency_key and block renderer if finalize not committed
Nora (Billing): SQL I ran to enumerate (staging first):
```
SELECT i.id, i.pdf_id, i.total_cents, count(ul.*) as usage_line_count, count(d.*) FILTER (WHERE d.discount_code = 'RESERVED_MONTHLY') as reserved_discount_count
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN invoice_usage_lines ul ON ul.invoice_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN invoice_discounts d ON d.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.batch = 'finalize-203'
GROUP BY i.id, i.pdf_id, i.total_cents
HAVING count(d.*) FILTER (WHERE d.discount_code = 'RESERVED_MONTHLY') > 1 OR count(ul.*) = 0;
```
Olivia (Finance): sign-off: approve credits up to $500 for impacted customers in this batch. Use note "System-generated correction: duplicate discount applied due to invoice finalize retry."
Tariq: I'll open a PR to add an idempotency_key to finalize and add a guard in renderer to assert finalize_committed before rendering. Also adding a one-hour window to disable auto-retry for finalize jobs while we sweep.
Ben R: I'll run the consistency query in staging now and push to prod after validation. Expect list in ~15m.
Nora (Billing): I'll draft customer communication for NimbleApps and attach the corrected invoice + credit note once numbers are finalized.
Ivy L: filing ticket FIN-4377, tagging @Olivia (Finance) and @Tariq for the patch. Updating ticket with the SQL and customer sample.
Olivia (Finance): thanks. prioritize NimbleApps and any customers with credit > $50 for manual outreach. :email:
Ben R: results: 5 invoices affected (nimbleapps, quickship, orchard-io, bytewave, greenfield). I'll post the invoice ids in FIN-4377 when done.
Nora (Billing): disabling finalize auto-retry for next 1h. Billing Bot: ACTION: job finalize-203 paused by @Nora (Billing)
Ivy L: good work. keep replies short. we'll coordinate credits and sends through FIN-4377. :white_check_mark:
